say:1:1130331001:1.text: He's our strongest warrior and an inspiration to us all!
say:1:1130331001:1.source_cn: 他是我们最强的勇士，也是最令人心折的族长！
say:1:1130331001:1.male: He's our strongest warrior and an inspiration to us all!
say:1:1130331001:1.female: He's our strongest warrior and an inspiration to us all!

say:2:1130331002:1.text: No one could ever match his strength, and I've sworn to follow him anywhere.
say:2:1130331002:1.source_cn: 他有着无人能敌的强大能力，我誓死追随他。
say:2:1130331002:1.male: No one could ever match his strength, and I've sworn to follow him anywhere.
say:2:1130331002:1.female: No one could ever match his strength, and I've sworn to follow him anywhere.
